name: HEAD TRAMPOLINE
blurb: Air heavy bounces them 80 px and refunds a jump. Kill on the bounce is always blunt.

name: FAMILY DISCOUNT
blurb: Your hits refill the partner's Steam. Shared combo lives if only one of you eats dirt.

name: OFFICE RAGE
blurb: Lights apply Staple bleed. Staple-kills explode paper. Lights still flash red until then.

name: QUIET LUNCH

name: DOUBLE SLAP

name: RICOCHET POLICY
blurb: Batwings bounce +1 off metal. Neon that is hit is a conversation.

name: TUTORING
blurb: Every 8th light without eating dirt: the next shot fires twice. Homework.

name: PENDULUM POLITICS
blurb: A web-slam kill leaves a lamp. The Son can grab it. Solo: you still get the lamp.

name: STEAM TAX

name: FAMILY BLITZ

name: STREET CREDIT

name: COPING MAGNET
blurb: Pickup vacuum radius +110. Halls of Torment called it a trait. We call it enabling.

name: ORBIT FORM
blurb: Two blades orbit you and chip. Not a meadow. Still illegal in group.

name: DRIP FEED
blurb: Aura ticks light on anything in hugging distance. The clinic calls it presence.

name: VACUUM HOUR
blurb: One huge magnet pulse. Every chip remembers your name. Then it forgets again.

name: OPEN TAB
blurb: Kills pay +4 pinball to whoever landed it. The clinic calls it a tab. We call it a personality.

name: INVOICE VOID
blurb: Legendary. Heavies strip an extra plate on armored bosses. The Director hates this card.

name: NAMED LINE
blurb: Perfect tricks pay +12 and keep the speed. The coach would bill this. Unique card art.

name: STOMP POLICY
blurb: Face stomps score double. Brain on three is still the personality.

name: IDLE ALIBI
blurb: Legendary. Patrol banks +50% gold. Closed still counts. The alley works for you.

name: COURIER POLICY
blurb: On the lemon van, rail shots refund 1 ammo. The clinic still bills the crash.

name: ORCHARD COPAY
blurb: Slide hills and rope swings pay +8. Hay is not a couch. The lake still wants a copay.

name: BRINE LUNGS
blurb: Legendary. In Ledger Dive, magnet radius +80 and eels chip slower. The spa hates this.

name: WALL BOUNCE
blurb: Throws bounce off smashables AND the invoice wall. SoR4 called it a juggle. We bill it.

name: SNACK BREAK
blurb: Smash a fridge or kiosk and the combo does not die. Extra scrap. The till still wants a copay.

name: REVENGE POLICY
blurb: After you eat dirt, the next hit is a Revenge. Longer window. SoR4 special restore, billed.

name: CART HOP
blurb: Shopping carts last longer. Jump off for a pop. Don't tell tutoring.

name: WEAPON CATCH
blurb: Thrown pipes bounce back once. SoR4 called it a juggle. We call it recycling.

name: CLASH POLICY

name: AWNING HOP

name: NEWS CYCLE

name: POLE VAULT
blurb: Streetlight swings launch higher. Sunset Overdrive rented the lamp. Tutoring can wait.

name: DIVE BOUNCE

name: HOOD HOP
blurb: Car hoods bounce higher. Sunset Overdrive rented the bumper. We stole the copay.

name: STEAM LID
blurb: Pop a manhole and nearby punks eat the steam. SoR4 hid knives under crates.

name: SLIDE TAX
blurb: Slides last longer and cut a second invoice. Vector went under. We billed the asphalt.

name: ESCAPE CLAUSE

name: TALKING STICK
